features.name: Safe Claw booster

review:
No reels – just a claw machine. Five symbols ride a conveyor belt, and a claw tries to grab one (sometimes dropping it). Grab the bonus symbol without dropping it for three Claw Spins, with three more for each extra bonus.

A paid Safe Claw booster stops the drops. More arcade game than slot, and fun to watch. High volatility, 10,000x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
